confidence_notes: I ran two searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Casablanca prices. The price search returned crowdsourced MyLifeElsewhere averages for beer (about $3.5 per pint), cappuccino (about $2.0-2.4) and an inexpensive meal (about $5.5). It found no wine, cocktail or mid-range meal prices. The mid-range meal for two is estimated from the inexpensive meal price. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, with restaurant and bar markups for alcohol in Morocco. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked. The RBA search results gave two figures: 0.6677 for 19 Nov 2026 in the latest-rates table, and 0.6720 for 18 Nov on the overview page. I used the 0.6677 table value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Casablanca crowdsourced price indexes. Other Moroccan cities such as Marrakech and Rabat have similar levels, and Casablanca is somewhat pricier for business-oriented hotels.
